name: DB Snapshots
author: Raj Shimpi
description: One-click snapshots of your projects' local PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB and SQLite databases before a risky migration, and a restore that asks first and saves a safety snapshot. Finds databases in project .env files, running Docker containers and the local PostgreSQL server. Databases on other machines or hosted services are listed but never touched.

barWidget.description: Snapshot and restore local project databases
